# CertBench

> Guided CompTIA exam prep. Pick your exam and CertBench lays out every exam objective as a path of short, interactive stops — quick questions first, the real exam's wording as you go — with a readiness checkpoint that shows where you stand, for CompTIA Security+ (SY0-701 and SY0-801), Network+ (N10-009), and A+ (Core 1 and Core 2). Every question is original and comes with a full explanation. No braindumps or leaked exam content.

## Which exam versions this covers

- Security+: a guided path for each version. SY0-701 is open until June 11, 2027 in English; SY0-801 (Security+ V8) is the version CompTIA now recommends. Pro covers both versions. For SY0-801 there are also a free practice test and free AI-threat practice questions.
- Network+: written for N10-009, the current exam.
- A+: written to 220-1201 and 220-1202 (CompTIA's V15), the current exams. CompTIA retired 220-1101 and 220-1102 on September 25, 2025.

## Guided study paths

Each path starts with a warm-up anyone can play with no account. A free account keeps your progress and opens the next stops through the readiness checkpoint; Pro opens the rest of the path.

- [Security+ study path (SY0-801)](https://certbench.dev/path/security-plus-sy0-801): all 27 objectives, the new AI objective included, one short stop each, with domain practice and a readiness checkpoint.
- [Security+ study path (SY0-701)](https://certbench.dev/path/security-plus-sy0-701): all 28 objectives, one short stop each, with domain practice and a readiness checkpoint.
- [Network+ study path (N10-009)](https://certbench.dev/path/network-plus-n10-009): the N10-009 topics, from the OSI model to troubleshooting.
- [A+ Core 1 study path (220-1201)](https://certbench.dev/path/a-plus-core1-220-1201): mobile devices, networking, hardware, virtualization and cloud, and troubleshooting.
- [A+ Core 2 study path (220-1202)](https://certbench.dev/path/a-plus-core2-220-1202): operating systems, security, software troubleshooting and operational procedures.

## Guides

- [Security+ SY0-801 exam guide](https://certbench.dev/security-plus-sy0-801): the launch date, the five domains and their weights, all 27 objectives, the new AI objective, and how to prepare now.
- [Security+ SY0-801 vs SY0-701](https://certbench.dev/security-plus-sy0-801-vs-sy0-701): launch and retirement dates, domain weight changes, and how to choose by exam date, from CompTIA's own pages.
- [SY0-701 exam objectives](https://certbench.dev/objectives/security-plus-sy0-701): every objective by domain and exam weight, with practice questions for each one.
- [220-1201 exam objectives (A+ Core 1)](https://certbench.dev/objectives/a-plus-core1-220-1201): all 27 objectives by domain and exam weight, with practice questions for each one.
- [220-1202 exam objectives (A+ Core 2)](https://certbench.dev/objectives/a-plus-core2-220-1202): all 36 objectives by domain and exam weight, including the new cloud productivity and AI objectives.

## Free tools

The port, subnetting, and acronym drills give a first round free with no account; a free account keeps going, saves progress, and builds each round from what you missed. The subnet calculator needs no account.

- [Port numbers quiz](https://certbench.dev/tools/port-numbers-quiz): drill the ports and protocols CompTIA tests, in both directions (name the port, name the protocol), with instant feedback.
- [Subnetting practice](https://certbench.dev/tools/subnetting-practice): rapid CIDR and subnet-mask drills for Network+ and A+.
- [Subnet calculator](https://certbench.dev/tools/subnet-calculator): enter an IPv4 address and CIDR prefix to get the network, broadcast, usable host range, subnet mask, wildcard mask, and host count.
- [Security+ acronyms list and quiz](https://certbench.dev/tools/security-plus-acronyms-quiz): the full SY0-701 acronym list, and a drill on the ones most tested on the exam.

## Free practice tests

- [CompTIA A+ practice test (Core 1 & Core 2)](https://certbench.dev/a-plus-practice-test): free practice questions with explanations, written to 220-1201 and 220-1202.
- [CompTIA A+ Core 1 practice test (220-1201)](https://certbench.dev/a-plus-core-1-practice-test): a free warm-up and practice questions with explanations, across all five Core 1 domains.
- [CompTIA A+ Core 2 practice test (220-1202)](https://certbench.dev/a-plus-core-2-practice-test): a free warm-up and practice questions with explanations, across all four Core 2 domains.
- [CompTIA Network+ practice test (N10-009)](https://certbench.dev/network-plus-practice-test): free N10-009 practice questions with explanations.
- [CompTIA Security+ practice test (SY0-701)](https://certbench.dev/security-plus-practice-test): free SY0-701 practice questions with full explanations.
- [CompTIA Security+ SY0-801 practice test](https://certbench.dev/security-plus-sy0-801-practice-test): 45 original questions in 45 minutes, at least one on each of SY0-801's 27 objectives in the exam's domain weights, timed and scored by domain, with every answer explained. No account needed.
- [SY0-801 AI practice questions](https://certbench.dev/security-plus-sy0-801-ai-practice-questions): 14 original questions on objective 2.6, the threats and vulnerabilities of AI, from prompt injection and poisoning to jailbreaking and hallucinations, each with the answer explained.

## Performance-based questions (interactive)

- [Security+ PBQ examples](https://certbench.dev/security-plus-pbq-examples): interactive performance-based questions — firewall rules, log analysis, incident response — you can work through in the browser.
- [Network+ PBQ examples](https://certbench.dev/network-plus-pbq-examples): interactive topology, configuration, and troubleshooting scenarios.
- [A+ Core 1 PBQ examples](https://certbench.dev/a-plus-core-1-pbq-examples): ports, hardware faults, and SOHO network setup.
- [A+ Core 2 PBQ examples](https://certbench.dev/a-plus-core-2-pbq-examples): malware removal, Windows tools, and mobile security scenarios.

## About

- [Readiness check](https://certbench.dev/readiness-check/security-plus-sy0-701): a free 3-minute check that estimates how ready you are, no account required.
- [Pricing](https://certbench.dev/pricing): the start of every path is free; Pro opens the whole path, unlimited practice, full-length exams, hands-on PBQ labs, and a readiness score.
- Certifications covered: CompTIA Security+ SY0-701 and SY0-801, Network+ N10-009, A+ Core 1 and Core 2 (220-1201 and 220-1202).
